cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the SEO Expert position at WPP Media. With over two years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical audits, content optimization, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), I am drawn to WPP's innovative approach to search and media. I am eager to contribute to your Total Search Activation team and help clients navigate the evolving search landscape.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and have built and maintained WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I regularly use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics to track performance and guide decisions. My experience also includes technical SEO audits, content gap analysis, and writing SEO content briefs.

On my own project, mirook.com, I have implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on GEO work has given me practical insights into optimizing for AI search, a key area for WPP Media.

I am fluent in English, speak Turkish natively, and have a B1 level in Dutch, which I am actively improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am comfortable working in international teams.

I am particularly excited about WPP's access to beta features and data from Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI, and I am keen to develop my SEA knowledge to contribute to Total Search projects. I am a curious and collaborative learner, always seeking to understand the business impact of search beyond rankings.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, technical SEO audits, keyword research, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility), content gap analysis, internal linking analysis
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, SEO content briefs, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score
